usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products and orders, and Bria AI creates pictures through “Generate Image” from a text prompt.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Generate Image” in Bria AI
bestTemplate.why: A new product can start images made from a text prompt you write.

watchOut: “Generate Image” in Bria AI builds pictures only from your prompt, so write it for each “New Product”.
